programs.name: Preschool Swim 2: Stingray

programs.name: Ultra Swim 1
programs.description: Make a splash with lessons to improve your swim skills. Learn how to enter and exit the pool, go underwater, breathe effectively and float with assistance.

programs.name: Ultra Swim 2
programs.description: Jump into lessons to improve your swim skills. Develop front swim, back kicks and glides. Learn how to stay afloat in deep water, side glide and kicking. Work towards a continuous swim of five metres.Prerequisite: Successful completion of or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 1 or Preschool Swim  3.

programs.name: Ultra Swim 4
programs.description: Dive into lessons to improve your swim skills. Develop front crawl and treading water. Learn side breathing, somersault, whip-kick and forward roll. Work towards a continuous swim of 25 metres. Prerequisite: Successful completion of or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 3.

programs.name: Ultra Swim 5
programs.description: Dive into lessons to improve your swim skills. Develop front dive, forward roll and front crawl. Learn back crawl, eggbeater kick and elementary backstroke. Work towards a continuous swim of 75 metres.Prerequisite: Successful completion of or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 4.

programs.name: Ultra Swim 5
programs.description: Dive into lessons to improve your swim skills. Develop front dive, forward roll and front crawl. Learn back crawl, eggbeater kick and elementary backstroke. Work towards a continuous swim of 75 metres.Prerequisite: Successful completion of or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 4.

programs.name: Ultra Swim 6
programs.description: Dive into lessons to improve your swim skills. Develop front crawl, back crawl, elementary backstroke and eggbeater kick. Learn stride entries, surface dives, breaststroke and interval training.  Work towards a continuous swim of 150 metres. Prerequisite: Successful completion of or skill ability equal to Ultra Swim 5.

programs.name: Ultra Youth Swim 1
programs.description: Build confidence in the water and improve your swimming skills. Learn front and back swim, front, side and back glides, going underwater, breathing effectively and staying afloat in deep water. Work towards a continuous swim of 25 to 50 metres.

programs.name: Ultra Youth Swim 2

programs.name: Adult Swim 1

programs.name: Adult Swim 2

programs.name: Guardian Swim 1

programs.description: Learn historic recipes and cooking techniques each day, and celebrate with a wood-fired pizza feast along with crafts, games, and outdoor fun.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Farmer, Baker, Toymaker at Gibson House
programs.description: Learn how to be a 19th century tradesperson for the week. See how farmers use produce from the garden for cooking, how bakers work in the kitchen, and how toymakers make toys from different materials.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Gather in Nature at Colborne Lodge
programs.description: Join us this summer for camp at Colborne Lodge! This camp will focus on being outside in beautiful High Park! Campers will learn about the Indigenous stewards of this land, past, present and future and get to know the historic house of the Howards, one of the European settlers of High Park.  This camp takes place primarily outside in the park and is supplemented by fun camp activities, such as crafts and games which will take inspiration from our surroundings. Spaces are limited, so register soon to secure a spot!

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: S.T.E.A.M. at Scarborough Museum
programs.description: Dive into exciting science experiments, experience cooking and baking in historic kitchens, unleash creativity with arts and crafts, take part in outdoor adventures and engage with the museum's fascinating artifacts and historic houses.       Campers will participate in weekly guest workshops led by local artists, community groups, firefighters, paramedics, and more.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Secret Garden at Spadina Museum
programs.description: Be immersed in the beautiful gardens to learn about nature, plants, wildlife and the history of this land. Using seasonal produce of the kitchen garden, make delicious treats in the kitchen of the historic coach house. Inspired by nature and the beautiful art in the museum, this camp has plenty of arts and crafts for children to unleash their imagination and creativity to express themselves through paint, clay, collage and more.  Campers bring their curiosity and travel back in time to the 1920s to discover the secrets of the house and uncover amazing and surprising history.  In addition to the extensive outdoor space, campers have a cool and comfortable home base in the and make special visits throughout the historic mansion as well.

Campers will have an opportunity to learn about preservation and the identification of plants and animals by exploring the environment. As well, using nature as inspiration, campers will create art projects, from drawings and paintings to relief art and sculpture.In addition to the minimum two hours a day focusing on arts and nature, you will also enjoy games, arts, sports and swim days dependent on weather and camp location. A trip or on-site special experience will be included, such as themed events, clinics or workshops to further enhance the camp program.

programs.description: Learn historic recipes and cooking techniques each day, and celebrate with a wood-fired pizza feast along with crafts, games, and outdoor fun.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Farmer, Baker, Toymaker at Gibson House
programs.description: Learn how to be a 19th century tradesperson for the week. See how farmers use produce from the garden for cooking, how bakers work in the kitchen, and how toymakers make toys from different materials.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Gather in Nature at Colborne Lodge
programs.description: Join us this summer for camp at Colborne Lodge! This camp will focus on being outside in beautiful High Park! Campers will learn about the Indigenous stewards of this land, past, present and future and get to know the historic house of the Howards, one of the European settlers of High Park.  This camp takes place primarily outside in the park and is supplemented by fun camp activities, such as crafts and games which will take inspiration from our surroundings. Spaces are limited, so register soon to secure a spot!

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: S.T.E.A.M. at Scarborough Museum
programs.description: Dive into exciting science experiments, experience cooking and baking in historic kitchens, unleash creativity with arts and crafts, take part in outdoor adventures and engage with the museum's fascinating artifacts and historic houses.       Campers will participate in weekly guest workshops led by local artists, community groups, firefighters, paramedics, and more.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Secret Garden at Spadina Museum
programs.description: Be immersed in the beautiful gardens to learn about nature, plants, wildlife and the history of this land. Using seasonal produce of the kitchen garden, make delicious treats in the kitchen of the historic coach house. Inspired by nature and the beautiful art in the museum, this camp has plenty of arts and crafts for children to unleash their imagination and creativity to express themselves through paint, clay, collage and more.  Campers bring their curiosity and travel back in time to the 1920s to discover the secrets of the house and uncover amazing and surprising history.  In addition to the extensive outdoor space, campers have a cool and comfortable home base in the and make special visits throughout the historic mansion as well.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Todmorden Mills
programs.description: CampTO at Todmorden MillsCampTO at Todmorden Mills invites campers to immerse themselves in the nature and history of the Don Valley.  Experience the unique history and natural landscape of Todmorden Mills through special guided tours of the Wildflower Preserve, Papermill Gallery, and the two historic homes. This camp features standard camp activities including outdoor play, crafts, and activities inspired by the nature and history of the valley.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Cooking Camp At Montgomery’s Inn
programs.description: Learn historic recipes and cooking techniques each day, and celebrate with a wood-fired pizza feast along with crafts, games, and outdoor fun.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Farmer, Baker, Toymaker at Gibson House
programs.description: Learn how to be a 19th century tradesperson for the week. See how farmers use produce from the garden for cooking, how bakers work in the kitchen, and how toymakers make toys from different materials.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Gather in Nature at Colborne Lodge
programs.description: Join us this summer for camp at Colborne Lodge! This camp will focus on being outside in beautiful High Park! Campers will learn about the Indigenous stewards of this land, past, present and future and get to know the historic house of the Howards, one of the European settlers of High Park.  This camp takes place primarily outside in the park and is supplemented by fun camp activities, such as crafts and games which will take inspiration from our surroundings. Spaces are limited, so register soon to secure a spot!

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: S.T.E.A.M. at Scarborough Museum
programs.description: Dive into exciting science experiments, experience cooking and baking in historic kitchens, unleash creativity with arts and crafts, take part in outdoor adventures and engage with the museum's fascinating artifacts and historic houses.       Campers will participate in weekly guest workshops led by local artists, community groups, firefighters, paramedics, and more.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Secret Garden at Spadina Museum
programs.description: Be immersed in the beautiful gardens to learn about nature, plants, wildlife and the history of this land. Using seasonal produce of the kitchen garden, make delicious treats in the kitchen of the historic coach house. Inspired by nature and the beautiful art in the museum, this camp has plenty of arts and crafts for children to unleash their imagination and creativity to express themselves through paint, clay, collage and more.  Campers bring their curiosity and travel back in time to the 1920s to discover the secrets of the house and uncover amazing and surprising history.  In addition to the extensive outdoor space, campers have a cool and comfortable home base in the and make special visits throughout the historic mansion as well.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Todmorden Mills
programs.description: CampTO at Todmorden MillsCampTO at Todmorden Mills invites campers to immerse themselves in the nature and history of the Don Valley.  Experience the unique history and natural landscape of Todmorden Mills through special guided tours of the Wildflower Preserve, Papermill Gallery, and the two historic homes. This camp features standard camp activities including outdoor play, crafts, and activities inspired by the nature and history of the valley.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Cooking Camp At Montgomery’s Inn
programs.description: Learn historic recipes and cooking techniques each day, and celebrate with a wood-fired pizza feast along with crafts, games, and outdoor fun.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Farmer, Baker, Toymaker at Gibson House
programs.description: Learn how to be a 19th century tradesperson for the week. See how farmers use produce from the garden for cooking, how bakers work in the kitchen, and how toymakers make toys from different materials.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Gather in Nature at Colborne Lodge
programs.description: Join us this summer for camp at Colborne Lodge! This camp will focus on being outside in beautiful High Park! Campers will learn about the Indigenous stewards of this land, past, present and future and get to know the historic house of the Howards, one of the European settlers of High Park.  This camp takes place primarily outside in the park and is supplemented by fun camp activities, such as crafts and games which will take inspiration from our surroundings. Spaces are limited, so register soon to secure a spot!

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: S.T.E.A.M. at Scarborough Museum
programs.description: Dive into exciting science experiments, experience cooking and baking in historic kitchens, unleash creativity with arts and crafts, take part in outdoor adventures and engage with the museum's fascinating artifacts and historic houses.       Campers will participate in weekly guest workshops led by local artists, community groups, firefighters, paramedics, and more.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Secret Garden at Spadina Museum
programs.description: Be immersed in the beautiful gardens to learn about nature, plants, wildlife and the history of this land. Using seasonal produce of the kitchen garden, make delicious treats in the kitchen of the historic coach house. Inspired by nature and the beautiful art in the museum, this camp has plenty of arts and crafts for children to unleash their imagination and creativity to express themselves through paint, clay, collage and more.  Campers bring their curiosity and travel back in time to the 1920s to discover the secrets of the house and uncover amazing and surprising history.  In addition to the extensive outdoor space, campers have a cool and comfortable home base in the and make special visits throughout the historic mansion as well.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Todmorden Mills
programs.description: CampTO at Todmorden MillsCampTO at Todmorden Mills invites campers to immerse themselves in the nature and history of the Don Valley.  Experience the unique history and natural landscape of Todmorden Mills through special guided tours of the Wildflower Preserve, Papermill Gallery, and the two historic homes. This camp features standard camp activities including outdoor play, crafts, and activities inspired by the nature and history of the valley.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Cooking Camp At Montgomery’s Inn
programs.description: Learn historic recipes and cooking techniques each day, and celebrate with a wood-fired pizza feast along with crafts, games, and outdoor fun.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Farmer, Baker, Toymaker at Gibson House
programs.description: Learn how to be a 19th century tradesperson for the week. See how farmers use produce from the garden for cooking, how bakers work in the kitchen, and how toymakers make toys from different materials.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Gather in Nature at Colborne Lodge
programs.description: Join us this summer for camp at Colborne Lodge! This camp will focus on being outside in beautiful High Park! Campers will learn about the Indigenous stewards of this land, past, present and future and get to know the historic house of the Howards, one of the European settlers of High Park.  This camp takes place primarily outside in the park and is supplemented by fun camp activities, such as crafts and games which will take inspiration from our surroundings. Spaces are limited, so register soon to secure a spot!

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: S.T.E.A.M. at Scarborough Museum
programs.description: Dive into exciting science experiments, experience cooking and baking in historic kitchens, unleash creativity with arts and crafts, take part in outdoor adventures and engage with the museum's fascinating artifacts and historic houses.       Campers will participate in weekly guest workshops led by local artists, community groups, firefighters, paramedics, and more.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Secret Garden at Spadina Museum
programs.description: Be immersed in the beautiful gardens to learn about nature, plants, wildlife and the history of this land. Using seasonal produce of the kitchen garden, make delicious treats in the kitchen of the historic coach house. Inspired by nature and the beautiful art in the museum, this camp has plenty of arts and crafts for children to unleash their imagination and creativity to express themselves through paint, clay, collage and more.  Campers bring their curiosity and travel back in time to the 1920s to discover the secrets of the house and uncover amazing and surprising history.  In addition to the extensive outdoor space, campers have a cool and comfortable home base in the and make special visits throughout the historic mansion as well.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Todmorden Mills
programs.description: CampTO at Todmorden MillsCampTO at Todmorden Mills invites campers to immerse themselves in the nature and history of the Don Valley.  Experience the unique history and natural landscape of Todmorden Mills through special guided tours of the Wildflower Preserve, Papermill Gallery, and the two historic homes. This camp features standard camp activities including outdoor play, crafts, and activities inspired by the nature and history of the valley.

programs.name: CampTO Plus: Arts and Nature
programs.description: This camp combines the study of ecology and art. Campers will have an opportunity to learn about preservation and the identification of plants and animals by exploring the environment. As well, using nature as inspiration, campers will create art projects, from drawings and paintings to relief art and sculpture.In addition to the minimum two hours a day focusing on arts and nature, you will also enjoy games, arts, sports and swim days dependent on weather and camp location. A trip or on-site special experience will be included, such as themed events, clinics or workshops to further enhance the camp program.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Farmer, Baker, Toymaker at Gibson House

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Gather in Nature at Colborne Lodge
programs.description: Join us this summer for camp at Colborne Lodge! This camp will focus on being outside in beautiful High Park! Campers will learn about the Indigenous stewards of this land, past, present and future and get to know the historic house of the Howards, one of the European settlers of High Park.  This camp takes place primarily outside in the park and is supplemented by fun camp activities, such as crafts and games which will take inspiration from our surroundings. Spaces are limited, so register soon to secure a spot!

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: S.T.E.A.M. at Scarborough Museum
programs.description: Dive into exciting science experiments, experience cooking and baking in historic kitchens, unleash creativity with arts and crafts, take part in outdoor adventures and engage with the museum's fascinating artifacts and historic houses.       Campers will participate in weekly guest workshops led by local artists, community groups, firefighters, paramedics, and more.

programs.name: CampTO Plus Museums: Secret Garden at Spadina Museum
programs.description: Be immersed in the beautiful gardens to learn about nature, plants, wildlife and the history of this land. Using seasonal produce of the kitchen garden, make delicious treats in the kitchen of the historic coach house. Inspired by nature and the beautiful art in the museum, this camp has plenty of arts and crafts for children to unleash their imagination and creativity to express themselves through paint, clay, collage and more.  Campers bring their curiosity and travel back in time to the 1920s to discover the secrets of the house and uncover amazing and surprising history.  In addition to the extensive outdoor space, campers have a cool and comfortable home base in the and make special visits throughout the historic mansion as well.
